test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The length, breadth, and height of a room are 10 m, 8 m and 6 m respectively. Find the cost of white washing the walls of the room and the ceiling at the rate of Rs. 7.50 per m².
solution:
Given:

Length of room = 10 m

Breadth of room = 8 m

Height of room = 6 m

Rate of whitewashing = Rs 7.50 per m²

Concept Used:

Area of four walls of room = 2h (l + b)

Area of ceiling = l × b
